reports.title: Molly Russell: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: There was no separation between adult and child parts of the platforms or separate platforms for children and adults
concerns.hazard: lack of platform separation for children

concerns.quote: There was no age verification when signing up to the on-line platform
That the content was not controlled so as to be age specific
That algorithms were used to provide content together with adverts
That the parent, guardian or carer did not have access, to the material being viewed or any control over that material
That the child's account was not capable of being separately linked to the parent, guardian or carer's account for monitoring

reports.title: Oliver Gorman: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: Oliver's death from inhalation of the propellant (butane and/or propane) used in [REDACTED] aerosols is one of a number of deaths in the past few years. Over the past few years there have been a number of reported deaths in teenagers from the recreational use of [REDACTED] spray. Nothing appears to have changed in response to those deaths
The warnings on the cans of [REDACTED] of the danger/risk of inhaling the aerosol spray were, in my opinion, inadequate in terms of visibility and wording

The posting of challenges such as those listed above, and no doubt others, on social media platforms will continue to take the lives of young, impressionable and/or vulnerable children/teenagers unless the platform providers take responsibility fortheir content and/or toxic algorithms either voluntarily or through Government action

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that platform algorithms (or toxic algorithms) deliver harmful content to children without adequate safeguards. The earlier report focuses on algorithms pairing content with adverts and lack of age controls, while the later report warns that such algorithms enable deadly challenges to reach vulnerable youth.
links.earlier_quote: That algorithms were used to provide content together with adverts.
links.later_quote: unless the platform providers take responsibility fortheir content and/or toxic algorithms either voluntarily or through Government action
